## What changed

Describe the problem, the change, and any intentional behavior differences.
Link an issue when applicable.

## Validation

Record the exact commands and results. Distinguish synthetic checks from actual
installed-package, RDP, desktop, or Copilot acceptance. For UI changes, include
sanitized normal/minimum-size screenshots when practical.

## Review checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and includes regression coverage where behavior changes.
- [ ] Related public documentation and compatibility limits are current.
- [ ] No credentials, certificates, local profiles, logs, task data, generated binaries, or private reference code are included.
- [ ] Pairing, human approval, actor/logon ownership, cancellation and disconnect behavior remain enforced.
- [ ] Any SDK/runtime, native ABI, package identity or signing changes are explicitly explained.
- [ ] No live desktop operation, certificate trust change, or billable model request is implied by a synthetic test result.
